scope_note: Existing aggregate metrics were known before this audit. These rules are retrospective for current artifacts and prospective for synthetic-data comparisons.
target: force-platform initial contact for each foot

denominator.rule: Initial contact and next same-foot contact must both lie inside synchronized video coverage, with force stride duration from 0.45 through 1.20 seconds.

cause_rules.POSE_MISS: Within plus/minus two video frames of force initial contact, pose_detected fraction is below 0.60 or mean tracked heel/toe visibility is below 0.50.
cause_rules.FOOT_SWAP: No valid same-side stride candidate starts within 0.14 seconds of force initial contact, while an opposite-side candidate does.
cause_rules.SYNC_LOW: Trial-level absolute marker-to-video synchronization correlation is below 0.30.
cause_rules.STRIDE_MISS: No valid same-side stride candidate with a frozen-model prediction starts within 0.14 seconds of force initial contact.
cause_rules.MODEL_ERROR: A prediction exists but absolute onset error exceeds 30 milliseconds.
cause_rules.PASS: A prediction exists and absolute onset error is at most 30 milliseconds.

success_criteria_for_future_comparison.statistical_reporting: Report per-subject paired differences, effect size, and exhaustive paired sign-flip permutation p-value. Five of seven improved is a practical consistency gate, not a significance claim.

comparison_groups_for_future_synthetic_e: clean synthetic pretraining then Twente fine-tuning
BioCV-noise synthetic pretraining then Twente fine-tuning
leakage_rules: Fit BioCV-derived noise distributions independently inside every Twente LOSO training fold.
Never use the held-out Twente participant to set a noise distribution, threshold, feature, or checkpoint.
Never train, tune, or select with test2.MOV or test3.MOV.
Keep force-defined and visually annotated Landing F1 in separate result tables.
Report a null or negative synthetic-transfer result without changing the success criteria.
